scams.name: Kuching International Airport (KCH) Unlicensed Taxi & Grab-Cancellation Scam
scams.description: You exit KCH arrivals at Kuching and a man in a polo shirt approaches: 'Taxi to Waterfront, RM100.' The official airport-coupon counter inside arrivals charges RM30–RM40 fixed to central Kuching; Grab on airport Wi-Fi is RM18–RM30 with a small surcharge. LPKP Sarawak ran repeated 2024–2025 sweeps against unlicensed taxis at KCH; their May 2025 statement: 'LPKP Sarawak views seriously all allegations involving e-hailing vehicles.' Variant: your Grab driver accepts and messages 'app broken, WhatsApp please' or 'cancel lah, RM80 cash.' Cancel the ride yourself if the driver pressures you (no fee), photograph the plate before loading luggage, and refuse every 'day-trip package' pitched at the airport — book Bako and Semenggoh through the SFC portal.
scams.avoidance: Ignore every 'taxi?' approach in arrivals — use the official KCH coupon-taxi counter (RM30–RM40 to central Kuching) OR book Grab on airport Wi-Fi (RM18–RM30) Never pay cash upfront and never switch to WhatsApp — if the Grab driver asks you to cancel, you cancel and rebook Refuse every 'day-trip package' pitched at the airport — book Bako/Semenggoh through SFC or hotel concierge Report teksi sapu to MOTAC 1300-88-5050 or JPJ 1-800-88-7723
scams.location: Kuching International Airport (KCH) arrivals hall, coupon-taxi counter queues, Grab signposted pickup zone outside arrivals, Waterfront / Main Bazaar / Padungan hotel drop-offs
scams.tldr: Kuching International Airport (KCH) is Sarawak's main gateway and hosts the state's most-documented 2025 taxi-overcharge ecosystem.

scams.name: Bako National Park Boat-Fee & Unofficial 'Guide' Overcharge Scam
scams.description: At Kampung Bako jetty 37 km north of Kuching, a tout intercepts you on the walk to the boat counter: 'Combined boat plus guide plus park fee, RM250 per person.' The legitimate stack is RM20 foreigner park entry plus RM40 shared boat one-way — total RM60. The 16 color-coded trails are self-guided. Sarawak Forestry Corporation (SFC) runs the park and publishes real-time availability at ebooking.sarawakforestry.com. Pre-register and pre-pay there, take Grab (RM40–RM60) or Bus No. 1 from Kuching Open-Air Market (RM3.50) to the jetty, and buy your boat ticket only at the SFC counter — printed price list, RM40 shared. Refuse every 'guide' offer at the jetty; if you want one, SFC charges RM120 for a 3-hour group walk.
scams.avoidance: Pre-register and pre-pay online at the SFC Visitor Self-Registration Portal (ebooking.sarawakforestry.com) — foreigner entry is RM20 Buy boat tickets ONLY at the SFC / jetty-boatman counter at Kampung Bako — shared boat RM40 one-way, round-trip RM80 Refuse every 'guide' offer at the jetty — Bako day-hike trails are self-guided Grab or Bus No. 1 from Kuching (RM3.50) beats any 'day-trip package' pitched in town Report overcharging to SFC staff at Teluk Assam park HQ
scams.location: Kampung Bako village jetty (boat launch), Teluk Assam beach park HQ, SFC park-office counter, Bako trail heads (Telok Pandan Kecil, Telok Paku, Lintang), Kuching-based tour operators pitching 'day packages'
scams.tldr: Bako National Park, 37 km north of Kuching, is the state's most-visited national park and hosts the most-documented tourist-fee-overcharge pattern in Sarawak.

scams.name: Orangutan & Wildlife-Tour Bait-and-Switch (Semenggoh / Mulu Multi-Day Package Scam)
scams.description: In your Kuching hotel lobby, a tour-desk salesman quotes RM350 per person for a 'Semenggoh orangutan tour with guaranteed sightings.' No operator can guarantee a semi-wild orangutan — Semenggoh's daily attendance is posted on its Facebook page, and during fruiting season some days nobody comes to the platform. The real cost is a Grab round-trip plus the RM10 foreigner park entry — total RM60–RM100. The Star ran 'Nationwide clampdown begins on illegal tourism players' on 20 June 2025, with MOTAC-led sweeps targeting unlicensed Sarawak operators; MITTA flags 'no MOTAC license, cash-only, no written itinerary' as the universal red flags. For Mulu, book MASwings flights direct at maswings.com.my and accommodation at the SFC portal.
scams.avoidance: Book Semenggoh DIY — Grab is RM30–RM45 one-way, park entry RM10 foreigner, no guide needed MOTAC-licensed operators only — verify the license number before paying Demand itinerary, license, and cancellation terms IN WRITING; pay by card or traceable transfer, never cash-only No operator can 'guarantee' orangutan sightings — check the Semenggoh Facebook page for daily attendance For Mulu: book MASwings and SFC chalets DIRECT
scams.location: Kuching hotel lobbies (Waterfront, Padungan, Main Bazaar tour desks), KCH airport tour-desk counters, Semenggoh Nature Reserve gate, Damai Beach / Santubong tour offices, Kampung Bako jetty, Mulu and Niah National Park access points (Miri side)

scams.name: Iban Longhouse 'Cultural Tour' Hidden-Cost & Fake-Donation Scam
scams.description: A Kuching operator sells you a 'day longhouse visit with lunch, cultural show, and rice-wine tasting' at RM450 per person. On arrival the 'cultural show' is a 10-minute photo-op, lunch is instant noodles, and a 'community donation' of RM150 per head is demanded — none reaches the longhouse. Tuak priced at RM200 a bottle in the package costs RM30 in the village. The Star's 'Nationwide clampdown begins on illegal tourism players' (June 2025) and MITTA's 2025 travel-scam alerts both flag East Malaysia 'cultural tour' packages as high-risk. For a day visit, go DIY to Annah Rais — Grab round-trip RM80–RM120, transparent RM10–RM15 entrance fee, walk through unguided. For overnight Iban longhouse, book only via a MOTAC-licensed operator and verify the tuai rumah's contact before deposit; registered homestay is RM100–RM180 per head per night including meals.
scams.avoidance: For Annah Rais day trips: Grab round-trip from Kuching (RM80–RM120), transparent RM10–RM15 entry at the longhouse gate, no guide needed For overnight longhouse stays: MOTAC-licensed operators only — registered homestay rate is RM100–RM180 per head per night Refuse every 'community donation' not agreed in writing — they rarely reach the longhouse Buy tuak or handicrafts directly from longhouse residents, not operator-selected shops MOTAC tourist hotline 1300-88-5050 for complaints
scams.location: Annah Rais Bidayuh Longhouse (1 hr south of Kuching), Kuching hotel-lobby tour desks (Waterfront, Main Bazaar), Batang Ai reservoir Iban longhouses, Kapit / Rajang River longhouses, unlicensed operator offices on Jalan Carpenter and Main Bazaar
scams.tldr: A longhouse visit is one of Sarawak's signature experiences, and an authentic one with an Iban, Bidayuh, or Orang Ulu community can be memorable.

scams.name: Sarawak Cultural Village (SCV) Fake-Bundle & Unofficial Ticket-Reseller Scam
scams.description: A Kuching hotel tour desk pitches 'SCV entrance plus transfer plus lunch' at RM350 per person. The legitimate stack is RM90 foreigner entry direct from scvticket.com.my, plus RM40–RM60 Grab one-way to Damai Beach, plus RM25–RM40 lunch on-site — total RM165–RM210 maximum. SCV's official site shows real-time availability and includes both 11:30 AM and 4:00 PM cultural shows; there is no 'VIP show' tier in the pricing. For Rainforest World Music Festival 3-day passes, buy only at rwmf.net — Marketplace and Carousell counterfeits get scanned and rejected at the gate. Watch for 'student rate' resellers selling RM65 MyKad tickets to foreigners at RM90 — the barcode shows the discount and you'll be refused at the entrance.
scams.avoidance: Buy SCV tickets DIRECT at scvticket.com.my — RM90 foreigner adult, includes both cultural shows Transfer DIY: Grab is RM40–RM60 one-way, Damai Beach shuttle is RM10–RM15 — refuse inflated 'transfer packages' RWMF 3-day passes: ONLY buy at rwmf.net — never social media or unofficial resellers No 'VIP cultural show' exists in official SCV pricing — refuse every upsell Klook/Trip.com/Viator are legitimate but check final price for hidden transfer markups
scams.location: Sarawak Cultural Village (SCV), Pantai Damai Santubong (35 km north of Kuching), Damai Beach resort zone, Kuching hotel-lobby tour desks (Waterfront, Main Bazaar, Padungan), KCH airport tour-desk counters, Facebook/Carousell/Instagram RWMF ticket resellers
scams.tldr: Sarawak Cultural Village (SCV) at Damai Beach, Pantai Damai Santubong.

scams.name: Main Bazaar & Carpenter Street Money-Changer Shortchange Scam
scams.description: At a Main Bazaar money changer, the board shows a competitive rate (USD1 = RM4.72), but the cashier types a worse one into the calculator (RM4.55) and shows you the figure. He counts the MYR fast, folds it, and hands it back — RM50 short in the middle of the stack. Or the 'no commission' board ad turns into a 2–3% 'service fee' at handover. Sarawak Tribune covered a 2024 currency-exchange scam where a trader lost RM190,800; a Bank Negara license number (starting 'MSB') should be displayed on the counter, and BNM publishes the licensed list at bnm.gov.my. Count your MYR slowly in front of the cashier, then count it again before stepping away. Demand a printed receipt with rate, foreign amount, and MYR. For larger amounts, use a Maybank or CIMB ATM inside the branch during business hours.
scams.avoidance: Use only BNM-licensed money changers — look for the 'MSB' license number displayed at the counter Count MYR SLOWLY in front of the cashier, then count it AGAIN before walking away Always demand a printed receipt showing rate + foreign amount + MYR amount Refuse surprise 'commission' added at handover — it wasn't on the board For larger sums (USD500+), withdraw from Maybank or CIMB ATM during business hours BNM report hotline 1-300-88-5465
scams.location: Main Bazaar (riverside strip), Carpenter Street (Chinatown core), India Street pedestrian mall, Padungan Road, Kuching Waterfront promenade, unlicensed 'runners' approaching tourists on the street
